name: Human Heart (Anatomical 4-Chamber Coronal Cutaway)
semanticDescription: Anatomical human heart with coronal cutaway section revealing 4 internal chambers (Right Atrium, Right Ventricle, Left Atrium, Left Ventricle with ~3x thicker myocardium), interventricular and interatrial septa, atrioventricular valves (tricuspid and bicuspid/mitral) with chordae tendineae and papillary muscles, semilunar valves, coronary circulation, and great vessels.
simplifications: Coronal cutaway removes anterior myocardial wall to expose interior 4-chamber anatomy (RA, RV, LA, LV), septa, and valves for educational demonstration
Left ventricle myocardium authored with 12 mm wall thickness (~3x right ventricle 4 mm wall thickness) reflecting systemic vs pulmonary hydrostatic pressure requirements
Fibrous valve leaflets (tricuspid 3-cusp, mitral 2-cusp) and papillary chordae tendineae stylized for pedagogical clarity
Great vessels capped with manifold geometry to guarantee watertight 3D meshes

materials.look: Cardiac muscle tissue with subsurface scattering (0.55, 0.09, 0.11)
Atrial muscle wall with subsurface scattering (0.48, 0.10, 0.12)
Epicardial adipose tissue cushions along sulci
